prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive stage preview on pet selection: Redesign the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring an interactive live animation preview of the chosen pet.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "playful", "asset": "asset:pet_live_preview"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet quick controls walkthrough screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding screen illustrating basic desktop controls, how to summon or hide the pet, and interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_guide"], "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Learn the basic shortcuts to summon, hide, and interact with your pet directly on your desktop.", "layout": "checklist", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}
2: [finish, redesign] Checklist layout for desktop onboarding completion: Redesign the home introduction screen into a structured checklist verifying desktop permissions and pet placement.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready to Spawn!", "body": "Complete these quick checks to release your pet onto your desktop screen.", "button_label": "Launch Pet Now"}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet personality matching quiz sub-flow: Insert a 3-question pet personality matcher quiz right before pet selection to help users pick the best match.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_pet_quiz", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_quiz": {"headline": "Pet Personality Matcher", "body": "Answer 3 quick questions to discover which desktop companion fits your daily work style best.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "See My Matches"}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Split mascot overview on path selection: Redesign the choose_path screen into a split layout featuring a friendly animated mascot explaining pre-made vs custom paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose How to Create Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a classic pre-made pet or generate a completely customized pet from your own photos.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "asset": "asset:path_guide_mascot"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Previous pet recovery sign-in hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing into their account restores their previous pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your existing account to automatically restore all previously saved pets and progress."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop render readiness status on waiting screen: Display a status hint on the waiting screen confirming that desktop window and rendering permissions are active.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Environment", "show_progress": true, "hint": "Checking screen permissions and preparing desktop overlay..."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Official pet adoption certificate badge preview: Add a visual verified badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Verified Desktop Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, layout] Spotlight focused layout for pet generation wait screen: Switch the waiting screen to a spotlight layout with a time estimate indicator.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "spotlight", "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your pet is getting ready to hop onto your desktop background!"}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Engaging story intro headline and call to action: Update the story intro headline and button copy to clearly explain the benefit of having an active desktop pet.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Sanctuary", "body": "Bring your computer screen to life with an intelligent, playful virtual companion who keeps you company while you work.", "button_label": "Choose Your Companion"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns pet selection with interactive stage preview while retaining pet selection functionality.
Adds a new post-onboarding desktop controls guide screen after home_intro without removing required steps.
Redesigns home intro screen into a checklist layout within allowed onboarding scope.
Inserts a pet personality matching quiz sub-flow before pet selection while retaining all required steps.
Redesigns choose path screen while clearly retaining both pre-made and custom pet creation options.
Adds a helpful sign-in hint explaining account pet restoration without requesting unnecessary data.
Adds desktop environment status and permissions hint to the waiting screen within onboarding.
Adds a verified companion badge to the adoption certificate maintaining official certification context.
Updates waiting screen layout with time estimate for a real pet generation process, complying with Rule 5.
Updates story screen intro text and call to action while maintaining its job of introducing the companion.
